_comment: MM DayZ server list. The Servers page cards, the Stats page and the automatic stats feed all read this one file, so edit servers here only. Fields per server: id = short unique name used in links and stats files (lowercase, no spaces; do not change once stats exist or history starts fresh). name / map / badge / description / style / slots = text shown on the site (leave style or slots as null to show 'Ask in Discord'). server_name = the full name in the DayZ server browser, shown so players can search for it. battlemetrics = optional BattleMetrics page link (null hides the button). dlc = DayZ DLC players must own to join (null = none needed). view = camera rule shown on the card, e.g. '1PP & 3PP' or '1PP only' (null hides the row). game_port = the port players connect to (null hides the copy button). query_port = the steamQueryPort from that server's serverDZ.cfg, used by the stats feed to check online status and player count (null = skip). cftools_server_api_id = the 'Server ID' from the CFTools Cloud server's API settings, used for leaderboards (null = no leaderboards for this server). color = this server's line colour on the population chart (checked for colour-blind safety, keep these three as they are). restart_hours_utc = hours of the day (0-23, UTC) when the server restarts, used to draw restart markers and the 'next restart' time; leave as [] if unknown. mods = tags shown on the card. image = optional screenshot path, e.g. assets/img/servers/deer-isle.jpg (null shows a placeholder).

blackbox._comment: MM BlackBox player stats (AI kills, travel, longest shot and so on). url = where the stats feed downloads each server's public_stats.json: the MM Server Agent on the server machine. {port} is replaced with the server's game_port below, {server} with its id (deer-isle, sakhal, nasdara) and {file} with the file name (public_stats.json, or public_stats_season_<id>.json after a wipe). agent_fingerprint = the agent's encryption key fingerprint (from check-agent.bat, also listed in trust/agents.jsonc in the mm-launcher repo); the feed only talks to the agent if its key matches, so nothing can pretend to be it. If the agent is ever reinstalled with a new key, update this line. The password lives in the BLACKBOX_TOKEN repository secret (made by stats-token.bat on the server), never in this file. Leave url empty ("") to switch the BlackBox boards off; the site then shows the CFTools boards. To leave one server out, add "blackbox": false to that server below.
